series: one-second means from the lap's start, as production's heat chain bins a lap: dur_s (seconds a bin stands for), v_ms, and the non-negative parts of the lateral the tyres hold (lat_pos: right turns) and of the longitudinal an accelerometer reads (long_pos: drive), in g
interpolation: log-log against lap_time_s between neighbouring knots

support.from: the car's laps at this layout; the slow end is its wet laps' at the layouts it has run in the wet (the wettest logged day)

fed.from: the median over the raw car's layouts (it has not run this one)
